title: AgentStartJob
description: The payload apps/api enqueues (scheduledAt minus 2 minutes, alongside the three candidate emails — see apps/api/src/lib/agentQueue.ts) on the 'agent-jobs' BullMQ queue, and apps/interview-agent picks up to start an interview (Phase 6). Everything else the agent needs (candidate CV, role blueprint, question bank) it looks up from Postgres directly by these ids — see apps/interview-agent/agent/db.py.
